explanation: Only active at D1, and only when the previous trial reached S1: about 8-10 if that S1 visit was unrewarded after choosing a1 (about 3-4 if S1 was reached rarely after choosing a2), and about 3-6 if it was rewarded after choosing a1, fading to 1-2 over a run of consecutive rewarded a1 trials. It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at every D1 after the previous trial reached S2, and after rewarded rare S1 visits from a2.
